name: Craft Meme Trailer
description: Turn one uploaded or Stash photo into a silent 10-second meme trailer: a 2-second opening title, 5 seconds of the photo with a setup caption, and a 3-second funny punchline card. Choose Save to Stash when uploading, then add an optional theme or exact punchline. Vision writes the punchline, EffectCraft renders static PNG title cards, and FilmCraft creates the final MP4 plus an editable timeline. No AI video generation or subject animation. Running Craft jobs pause the chain; inspect/collect the existing job instead of rerunning this recipe.

variables.trailer_delivery: Completed files and existing job IDs are in the Craft results. Inspect or collect a queued/running job before continuing; rerunning this recipe starts a new trailer.

# Meme Trailer

- 7–10 seconds: the punchline card.

Silent, 1280×720, 24 fps. Static title cards and photo, joined with straight cuts.
